statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I34.0, R55
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service was denied because it is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is medically necessary to identify the arrhythmic cause of these recurrent syncopal episodes
